description: Per-scenario regression thresholds used by scripts/dev/perf-compare.py. See docs/plans/shipped/pillar-1-2-perf-review-system.md § D2 for rationale. mean_abs_ceiling_ms (Pillar 1 absolute mean budget on avgPerCallMs, target 6.94 = 1000/144) ships null/DISABLED until the perf-gate-revival step-5 calibration pass — set it (plus perScenario overrides for legitimately-heavy scopes like SmatchetUI::Draw) only after observing real ci-windows-latest runs. mean_min_abs_delta_ms is the noise floor for the relative lastTotalMs gate: a relative regression only fires when the absolute delta also exceeds it — calibrated 2026-06-07 from the first armed CI run, where ai_chat.history.render_turn flagged +12.0% on 0.023 -> 0.026 ms (3 µs of single-frame sampling noise); 0.05 ms = 0.7% of the 6.94 ms frame budget.

perScenario.comment: Override the default for a specific scenarioId. Empty means inherit default. Tune ONLY when a real-world signal (CI false-positives, scenario noise) justifies it; document the rationale in the override entry.

cell-edit-burst.rationale: CI-only ceiling, user-approved 2026-06-07: median-of-3 p99 on the 2-core ci-windows-latest runner is persistently ~10.9 ms (10.879 measured; earlier single-run 'flakes' 10.140/17.354 were the same signal). cell-edit-burst is a deliberate edit-storm stress scenario, not steady-state UI; 2-core shared-runner timing != user hardware. The global 10.0 ms Pillar-1 floor stays for every other scenario. Whether cell-edit-burst exceeds 10 ms on real 144 Hz hardware is tracked as a GitHub Issue (perf-detective owns it) — if it does, that is a product perf bug and this override does NOT excuse it.
